items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: So each one of my wives I was married to five years, but I stayed with Olivia ten years.

ctx.x: Did you have any, did you have children by Jean? Doris, my second wife. Your second wife was Doris. Yeah. What year were you married to her?

Was it? Married to Doris around 1950. I was about 1950 and 1951. Then we stayed together five years. And I divorced her and married to Olivia. No, I didn't marry Olivia. No, I didn't marry Olivia. Olivia and I stayed together five years. Then after we stayed together five years, we decided to get married. We got married, stayed together five years and divorced us. So each one of my wives I was married to five years, but I stayed with Olivia ten years. So I want to get back to, when you, at Mary's Tavern, do you…
